اقتعدتما (form VIII)
# اِقْتَعَدْتُمَا (iqtaʕadtumā) /iq.ta.ʕad.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اُقْتُعِدْتُمَا (uqtuʕidtumā) /uq.tu.ʕid.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
